newsitem.title: USA: CBOT rice ends higher, but gains trimmed late.
newsitem.headline: CBOT rice ends higher, but gains trimmed late.

text.p: Most CBOT rice futures soared to fresh contract highs Wednesday, but a late round of market-on-close sell orders pushed the market to close near session lows, pit traders said.

Initial price strength was tied to technically-inspired commodity fund buying and expectations for the U.S. Department of Agriculture to show a cut in quarterly stocks data in its next report Friday, traders said.
"I think a lot of people are looking for a stocks reduction in the report," said one pit trader.
Some of the late weakness was profit-taking, traders said.
ING was a seller on the close and was also noted rolling short positions from January to March. Pit traders said that some commission houses were spreading July/September.
Rice volume was estimated at 400 contracts, down from 448 on Tuesday, according to CBOT data.
Rice closed 0.01 to 0.03 cent per cwt higher, with January up 0.01 at $11.14 and March up 0.03 cent at $11.25.
